title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 47225c4d9816… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 47225c4d98164ecd6ba909b6251f52c59317eb0c1abf29f277e9c771416a37db was observed twice on November 27, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer) and was seen originating from attacker infrastructure in Singapore. This hash fingerprints a specific malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security feeds for this indicator of compromise (IOC).
